articles.summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (NYSE: IVT) announced today that its Board of Directors declared a first quarter 2024 cash distribution of $0.226 per share of common stock, which represents a 5% year-over-year increase. When annualized, this is equal to a rate of $0.905 per share. This distribution will be paid on or about April 15, 2024, to stockholders of record as of March 31, 2024. About InvenTrust Properties Corp. InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“we,” the “Company,” “our,” “us,” "IVT" or "InvenTrust") is a premier Sun Belt, multi-tenant essential retail REIT that owns, leases, redevelops, acquires and manages grocery-anchored neighborhood and community centers as well as high-quality power centers that often have a grocery component.
